messages:
Alex Kim: quick sync on param naming in SDK snippets. i'm seeing `deployment_mode`, `deployment`, and `reserved_capacity` across pages. what's the least confusing public surface?
Nadia Ortiz: i'd vote for `deployment` (short) but `deployment_mode` is more explicit. avoid booleans.
Priya Singh: agree avoid booleans. small preference for `deployment` because fewer characters in examples, but fine either way as long as consistent.
Alex Kim: ok. proposal: canonical param name = `deployment` (string enum: "hosted" | "dedicated"), and docs should show both python/js examples using snake/camel respectively.
Nadia Ortiz: can we add an explicit example of the enum in docs? people copy-paste. e.g.:
```js
// JS example (client-js)
client.generate({ prompt: 'hi', deployment: 'dedicated' })
```
```py
# Python example (client-py)
client.generate('hi', deployment='dedicated')
```
Priya Singh: also need a migration snippet for folks still using `reserved_capacity=True` in older SDKs. maybe a one-liner: `if kwargs.pop('reserved_capacity', False): kwargs['deployment']='dedicated'` as a temporary shim.
Alex Kim: good idea. let's include a deprecation note: "Deprecated: reserved_capacity will be removed in 6 months; use 'deployment' instead." and show the shim code in /docs/migration/sdk-params.md.
DevDocs Bot: Auto: created tracker issue #921 for 'SDK param rename: reserved_capacity -> deployment' (https://github.com/redwood/docs/issues/921).
Nadia Ortiz: also cross-check CLI docs and REST examples. i found one REST example still showing `reserved_capacity=true` in /docs/api/reference. i'll open a PR to fix those.
Priya Singh: can we have a single short glossary entry so search finds both terms? e.g., "Dedicated (aka reserved capacity)" with canonical slug `dedicated`.
Alex Kim: yep. Nadia please add redirect rules for the old slug. i can update SDK snippets under /docs/sdk/ and add the migration note. who will write the changelog blurb?
Nadia Ortiz: i'll draft the changelog + release note. timeline: PRs for snippets + rest examples by Fri, glossary + redirects by Mon, migration doc by Wed. sound ok?
Priya Singh: works for me. I'll follow up with small code samples for TypeScript generics in the SDK page.
Alex Kim: thanks all. small style note: product names should be Title Case on first mention (Redwood Dedicated) and then use 'Dedicated' after. i'll add that to docs style guide quick note. closing thread when PRs are merged.
